key_insight: Neural triage decoding adaptively spends computation on difficult error patterns, achieving high accuracy with substantially lower latency for ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes.
engineering_relevance: Faster decoding of high-rate codes could help reduce physical-qubit overhead while keeping quantum error correction responsive to hardware timing constraints.
method: Use a local neural message-passing network to rapidly predict error corrections.
Add iterations when corrections leave residual syndrome violations.
Invoke a diversification search for the remaining unresolved cases.
evidence_signal: On lifted-product and Kasai codes encoding a few hundred logical qubits, the abstract reports accuracy comparable to near-optimal algorithmic decoders with approximately 10–100× lower decoding latency.
watch_item: Real-time deployment requires checking tail latency, since difficult cases trigger extra iterations and diversification.
paper_title: Fast and accurate neural triage decoding of ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes
